diffViewer.branchPickerGenerateFailed: Could not generate the diff. Choose a branch to retry.
diffViewer.copyFailedFilePath: Could not copy the file path.
diffViewer.copyFailedGitApplyCommand: Could not copy git apply command.
diffViewer.filesChangedSinceLoad: The files changed since this diff loaded.
diffViewer.noFileDiffs: No file diffs found in patch input.
diffViewer.optionNeedsHostSupport: Not available yet: cmux does not support this option
diffViewer.renderFailed: Could not render this diff. Check the patch input and try again.
diffViewer.splitDiffNeedsWiderPane: Split diff needs a wider pane
git.commit.allHint: Commits every change to tracked files, like git commit -a.
git.commit.failed: The commit failed. See git's output for details.
git.commit.hookFailed: A commit hook refused the commit. See its output below.
git.commit.identityMissing: git has no user name or email. Set user.name and user.email, then commit again.
git.commit.indexLocked: Another git process is using this repository. Retry when it ends.
git.commit.label: Commit
git.commit.mergeInProgress: A merge, rebase or cherry-pick is in progress. Finish it in a terminal first.
git.commit.newFiles: New files this commit adds (untracked, not ignored):
git.commit.newFilesChanged: The new files changed since the list was shown. Check the list, then commit again.
git.commit.newFilesFailed: The new files could not be listed, so they cannot be committed from here.
git.commit.newFilesSkipped: {n} more new files could not be listed, so new files cannot be committed from here. Clean them up or commit in a terminal.
git.commit.nothingToCommit: Nothing to commit. Stage changes first, or choose All.
git.commit.pathNotFound: A file to commit no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
git.commit.tooLong: The message is longer than 64 KiB. Shorten it to commit.
git.commit.uncertain: No answer came back, so the commit may have been made. Retry to check. It will not commit twice.
git.headMoved: HEAD moved since this view was read. Refresh to see the current state.
git.noSessionFolder: This chat has no folder on this Mac, so cmux cannot commit or push for it here.
git.notRepository: This chat's folder is not in a git repository.
git.notSent: Commit and Push need this chat's folder on this Mac and a connection to cmux.
git.push.authFailed: The remote refused the credentials. Check your SSH key or credential helper in a terminal.
git.push.branchNotFound: The branch no longer exists. Refresh to see the current state.
git.push.detachedHead: HEAD is detached. Check out a branch to push.
git.push.failed: The push failed. See git's output for details.
git.push.hookFailed: The pre-push hook refused the push. See its output below.
git.push.label: Push
git.push.mirrorRemote: The remote is a mirror, so cmux does not push to it. Push in a terminal.
git.push.networkFailed: The remote could not be reached. Check the network and retry.
git.push.noRemote: This repository has no remote to push to.
git.push.nonFastForward: The remote branch has commits this branch does not have. Pull or rebase in a terminal, then push again.
git.push.nothing: Nothing to push. The branch is up to date with its upstream.
git.push.publish: Push and track a new upstream branch
git.push.refspecConfigured: The remote has its own push settings, so cmux does not push to it. Push in a terminal.
git.push.rejectedByRemote: The remote refused the push. See its message below.
git.push.uncertain: No answer came back, so the push may have been sent. Retry to check. It will not push twice.
git.push.upstreamMismatch: This branch tracks a branch with another name, so cmux does not push it. Push in a terminal.
git.repositoryChanged: The folder now names another repository. Refresh and try again.
git.sessionChanged: This view was read for another chat. Refresh, then try again.
git.statusFailed: The branch state could not be read. Refresh and try again.
git.storeFailed: cmux could not record the result. Retry to check what git did.
git.timedOut: git did not finish in 2 minutes and was stopped. Retry to see what it did.
